test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A doctor who specialises in X-rays and other kind of radiations
solution:
The correct answer is** option 3) i.e. '****Radiologist'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the marked option:

 
 
• **Radiologist-** a doctor who specializes in the medical use of radiation, esp. X-rays.​
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:
 
 
• **Cardiologist-** a doctor who specializes in treating diseases of the heart.
 
• **Urologist-** a doctor who specializes in treating diseases of the parts of the body that produce and carry urine.
 
• **Nephrologist-** a doctor who specializes in conditions that affect the kidney.
 
 
 
• Hence, from the given meanings, **we find that ‘**Radiologist**’ is the correct one-word substitute.**
 
• So, **the correct answer is Option 3.**

 

**Correct one-word substitute:**__ *Radiologist*
